newsitem.title: USA: Virginia Pwr sees both nuke units up by Mon..
newsitem.headline: Virginia Pwr sees both nuke units up by Mon..

text.p: Virginia Power Co said Friday it expects to return to service by Monday two of its nuclear power units.
"Both Surry 2 and North Anna 2 should be back on line by Monday, maybe even this weekend," company spokesman Jim Norvelle said.

The 781 megawatt (MW) Surry 2 in Gravel Neck, Va., tripped off line December 13 while the operator was in the process of reducing power for a nine-day planned maintenance outage to repair a leaking pipe in the reactor coolant system.
The 909 MW North Anna 2 in Mineral, Va., tripped off line November 12 due to a generator problem.
Both North Anna 1 (911 MW) and Surry 1 (781 MW) nuclear units are operating at full power.
Virginia Power is a unit of Dominion Resources.
